entries.title: Single Clue
entries.description: One clue that may begin a hypothesis.

entries.title: Corroborated Clue
entries.description: Multiple clues agree on the same reading.

entries.title: Contradictory Clue
entries.description: A clue that points toward a competing interpretation.

entries.title: Insufficient Clue
entries.description: A clue that is not enough by itself.

entries.title: Contextual Reversal
entries.description: Later context reverses the initial reading.

entries.title: Exception Signal
entries.description: A signal that suggests quotation, fiction, history, or another exception.
